brief:
@buildthis.bisks.net eve online-type job using markov chains of skills, size/type constrained by the power plant of your ship
Multiple ships manageable at once (standardized stat block + swappable customizations), single world where shared state is lazy loaded by diffing PDS records for async pvp
note: skillchain: EVE-ish fleets where each ship is a Markov chain of skills bounded by its reactor; mine offline, duel other pilots async via PDS records. Needs sign-in to build.
